entities.summary: Francinaina Cirer Carbonell was a Spanish Roman Catholic member of the Sisters of Charity of Saint Vincent de Paul of Mallorca. She later assumed the religious name Francinaina of the Sorrowful Mother of God. Although she was illiterate, she went on to found the Community of the Sisters of Charity despite this impediment. She reportedly experienced angelic visions on numerous occasions. She was beatified on 1 October 1989 a second miracle attributed to her is currently under investigation.
